Extract Pseudo-Weighted Means or Category Prevalence

Source: R/coef.pwmean.R
coef.pwmean.Rd

Extracts pseudo-weighted estimates from an object returned by pwmean.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'pwmean'
coef(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An object of class "pwmean" or "pwmean_factor" returned by pwmean.

...

Additional arguments, currently unused.

Value

A named numeric vector of pseudo-weighted means for numeric outcomes, or category prevalence estimates for categorical outcomes.

Details

Values are taken from object$estimates$adjusted_mean, in row order. For numeric outcomes, names are the domain labels, including "Overall" when no domain variable was supplied.

For categorical outcomes, values estimate category prevalence. Names combine the category and domain labels separated by " | ", including "Overall" when no domain variable was supplied. Objects of class "pwmean_factor" inherit this method.

Unweighted estimates remain available in object$estimates. Participation model coefficients can be extracted from the original "pw_fit" object using coef.pw_fit.

See also

coef, pwmean, coef.pw_fit
